services.name: Inshore Fishing
services.desc: Snorkeling for Florida Scallops is like an Easter Egg Hunt but under water. Equipped with a snorkel, mask, fins or water shoes and a Scallop bag our guests find Scallops in 3ft - 10ft of water. Don’t be concerned about being skunked their are literally hundreds of thousands of scallops on the bottom of the waters we take you too. If you haven’t eaten Scallops before you are in for a big treat. Scallops are one of the tastiest critters you will ever pull from the sea. They are rich like lobster but have a sweet flavor to them.
